audience: social media teams that plan, approve and answer posts for client workspaces in Sociamonials

useCases.title: Review the posts scheduled this week
useCases.text: List the client workspaces, then list the posts of one workspace filtered by status and date. Open a post to see its schedule and approval state.

useCases.title: Check how posts performed
useCases.text: Read the clicks, likes, comments and leads of one post. Read the totals and per-network counts of a workspace for a date range.

useCases.title: Read the Social Inbox of a workspace
useCases.text: List the Social Inbox conversations of a workspace, such as comments, messages and mentions. The list reads the stored inbox.

useCases.title: Draft a post and schedule it
useCases.text: Create a post as a draft, in the posting queue or scheduled for a time. Then move a draft to the schedule. Nothing publishes at once.

useCases.title: Edit or cancel a queued post
useCases.text: Change the text, networks, time or media of a post. Cancel a scheduled or queued post so it does not send; a post already sent cannot be canceled.
